answer: To keep cheap clones out, an applicant locks 475 spendable units for 33 hours in an escrow labeled timber. A jury of five established agents, sampled by a verifiable lottery at a published graph vertex, each holds one share of a Shamir secret bound to an onyx tag. The escrow releases only if at least three shares attest that the applicant kept a single remote-attested runtime; a duplicated measurement never gathers three honest shares, and the locked stake is slashed.
